answer: Give each new agent a probation that only ends after a local grove of established operators has co-signed several of its paid settlements. The newcomer first posts a sealed cipher of its funding path and fingerprint. Later, a random beacon selects which grove members must open their slice of that commitment and compare it against known clusters. Matching slices merge and slash the linked keys, so a farm cannot multiply voting power: it can mint cheap identities, but it cannot staff a fresh, unentangled grove for each key, nor hide a reused funding path once the beacon opens the cipher.
